string.name: carousel_move_later
string.comment: Content description of the button that moves the centred carousel card one position towards the end of the list. Order-relative wording (not left/right) so it stays correct in right-to-left languages.

string.name: carousel_show_card
string.comment: Screen-reader label for any control that only reveals more detail about the item next to it - a carousel card that shows its details below, or an info button that opens a tooltip. It never activates or applies anything.

string.name: carousel_position
string.comment: Compact position readout shown between the reorder buttons. %1$d=position of the centred card starting at 1, %2$d=total cards. Example: 3 / 7

string.name: carousel_position_description
string.comment: Spoken form of carousel_position, read out by screen readers after each move. %1$d=position of the centred card starting at 1, %2$d=total cards. Example: Position 3 of 7
